entries.04b067f030b928e9: A business started in collaboration with Mitsubishi Materials Corporation, which recovers materials related to rare earths and rare metals from sources other than its own products and commercializes them.
entries.23c4bbad9c420727: Electric-furnace steelmakers and ferrous and non-ferrous scrap dealers to which recycled resources are delivered
entries.3b9ac98e6b1d4b2b: A holding company that sells new and used cars such as Honda vehicles and conducts automobile recycling in Mie Prefecture.
entries.5b30b4bd1005e7d3: Customers using vehicle inspection and maintenance services
entries.80d2c72bbaf418ab: A reportable segment that sells new and used cars and performs vehicle inspections and maintenance in Mie Prefecture. Honda Yonrin Hanbai Mie-Kita Co., Ltd. and Automall Co., Ltd. carry out this business, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥37,513 million.
entries.93ed6659125ea947: Honda Yonrin Hanbai Mie-Kita Co., Ltd. handles all new Honda vehicles at its 12 Honda Cars Mie-Kita stores, and Automall Co., Ltd. handles new imported vehicles at 2 Volkswagen stores and 2 Audi Mie stores.
entries.995bd26503bd1641: Under the Automobile Recycling Law, it properly dismantles end-of-life vehicles by hand and sells them as recycled resources. It holds certification as a fully recycling business operator.
entries.a42524ea5523876e: It sells reusable parts obtained from dismantling domestically and overseas, including in Malaysia and Russia, and also proposes them for maintenance and repairs within the group.
entries.aa8b91dd70d42d20: A reportable segment in which Mark Corporation Co., Ltd. dismantles end-of-life vehicles and sells recycled resources and reusable parts at the Suzuka Auto Recycle Center. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,424 million.
entries.d0c786e30e370733: At service workshops attached to its stores, it performs vehicle inspections, maintenance, repairs and parts sales, and also operates businesses such as car rental. It also sells automobile insurance as an agent of non-life insurance companies.
